subject: Draft MAP + signature runway — proposed target close and procurement blockers
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.m@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + signature runway — proposed target close and procurement blockers

Hi Jordan — thanks again for carving out time today. Short recap and next steps from our call: 

- Objective: align on MAP milestones that unblock your procurement and target a firm signature date.
- Proposed target signature: 2027-01-20 (we flagged this as an aggressive but achievable window if procurement approvals start this week).
- Primary procurement blocker you called out: external vendor evaluation checklist and a SOC2 evidence packet (security takes ~2 weeks once they receive the docs).

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (BluePeak_MAP_v2.xlsx) with milestones, owners, and tentative durations. Quick asks:
1) Confirm whether procurement requires a PO or legal countersign before vendor onboarding (affects our staging).
2) If possible, loop in the procurement mailbox so we can send SOC2 artifacts immediately (we can redact customer data).

I’m cc-ing Rishi and Marissa to confirm internal owners for SOW and signature approvals. If we can lock the procurement kickoff by next Tue (2026-12-15), I think the 2027-01-20 runway is realistic. If procurement timing slips, the MAP includes a fallback 2027-02-15 close.

Next steps (proposed):
- Jordan: confirm procurement contact and whether a PO is required (by Fri 12/11).
- Redwood: send SOC2 evidence + SOW-draft.pdf and updated MAP (today).
- Internal: Rishi/Marissa — confirm internal review SLA for SOW (48h typical for sales-reviewed SOW).

Attachments: BluePeak_MAP_v2.xlsx (milestone table), SOW-draft.pdf (redwood initial SOW).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short calendar invite for a procurement kickoff if you can share the procurement mailbox.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

--

From: Jordan Myers <jordan.m@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@bluepeakhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + signature runway — proposed target close and procurement blockers

Thanks Irene — useful recap. A couple quick clarifications from procurement: 

- Procurement does require a PO in parallel with the contract signature for our vendor onboarding. Legal typically signs before PO but procurement secures the PO number as part of internal bookkeeping.
- I’ll introduce you to our procurement lead (procurement@bluepeakhealth.com) — expect an intro by end of day.
- SOC2 evidence: procurement wants the Type II report and a short statement on data residency (we are US-only).

I looked at the MAP attachment briefly. Two notes:
1) Can we adjust the Milestone "Security evidence delivered" to show a 7–10 business day review window on our side rather than 2 weeks? I can try to expedite but don’t want to promise shorter.
2) For signature authority: our Director of Ops signs up to $100k; anything above needs CFO signoff which adds ~5 business days. That may push the run rate if our committed spend crosses that threshold.

Irene — I’ll send procurement contact and confirm which internal group will own the PO. If we get SOC2 and SOW this week we’ll aim to start legal review next Tue (12/15).

Jordan
Senior Program Manager | BluePeak Health
jordan.m@bluepeakhealth.com

Subject: Internal — confirm SOW review SLA and exec approval path for BluePeak

Folks — looping you quick. BluePeak flagged PO requirement + a potential CFO approval step if the annual commit is >$100k. Key asks from our side: 

- Rishi: can you confirm whether Redwood can sign with Director-level signatory for initial term and then add CFO countersign as an amendment if needed? If that’s not policy we should note it in the MAP.
- Marissa: we typically turn around sales-reviewed SOWs in 48 business hours — can you confirm your availability this week if BluePeak starts legal review on 12/15?

I’m keeping Jordan cc-ed for transparency. If we can confirm internal signoff flexibility, I’ll update the MAP to include a conditional milestone around CFO approval and the alternate 2/15 fallback.

Thanks — simple yes/no replies appreciated so I can push the updated MAP to BluePeak today.

Best,
Irene

From: Jordan Myers <jordan.m@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + signature runway — proposed target close and procurement blockers

Quick update — intro to procurement sent (procurement@bluepeakhealth.com). Procurement confirmed they need:
- Type II SOC2 report (pdf)
- Statement of data residency: US-only
- PO number allocated at time of signature

Procurement also said they will try to complete their internal checklist in 7–10 business days once they have the SOC2 and SOW. Given that, we’ll target legal signature week of 2027-01-17 with a target procurement PO issuance by 2027-01-20. That keeps your proposed 2027-01-20 signature runway feasible but tight.

Irene — please send SOC2 and SOW-draft.pdf to procurement@bluepeakhealth.com and copy me. If for any reason procurement signals delay past 1/20 we’ll revert to the fallback of 2027-02-15 and agree a short bridging conversation.

Thanks all — Jordan
